description: What a video with these choices costs in credits, and whether the team's balance covers it. Free.

ad.description: An ad to build the video like, its moves made for this product: a link of an ad in the Meta Ad Library, an ad's id from that library or from list_ads, which lists TikTok's ads too, or one of the team's own videos as v- and its id from get_video, with - and its part after for any but its first. A Meta Ad Library link not seen before is looked up in that library and counted against the team's ad links of the day. Not with lines or script_id.

angle.description: The angle the video argues: auto, the default, or one of the angle ids read_product lists for the product. Not with lines, script_id or ad, which argue their own.

captions.description: Captions of what is said, on screen. On by default.

count.description: How many videos to make, each a different take. Not with a script, which is made once for each presenter.

keep.description: What to keep of the ad: structure, the default, or pacing, its pace and its shots alone.

language.description: The language the video is spoken in. Left out, the team's ad language. Arabic, Hungarian and Japanese require quality best or priority.

languages.description: Up to 3 languages to make a script in at once, each its own video at one video's price, the first taking the place of language. Only with script_id, and not with language or lines; a script with words said as typed is made in one language, and the Arabic dialects go together, apart from every other language. Arabic, Hungarian and Japanese require quality best or priority.

placement.description: Where the product is in the video. auto by default.

presenters.description: Presenter ids from list_presenters. Left out, one is chosen for the product.

quality.description: fast, the default, uses Seedance 2.0 mini for trying ideas; best uses Wan 3.0 for the videos the team publishes; priority uses Wan 3.0 Prime, first in our line, at a higher price of its own, refused while it is not offered. seedance25 selects Seedance 2.5 explicitly, independent of the model used by best. Send these quality values, not model names.

resolution.description: The resolution it is filmed in, a higher one at a higher price: 480p or 720p for fast; 480p, 720p or 1080p for best and priority while 1080p is offered, one not offered being refused with the ones that are. Left out, the one its scripts were written for where script_id names them, else 480p while the team's balance is its free videos, else 720p. An Arabic video whose voice is added after filming is filmed in 720p whatever is asked. quote_video says which.

script.description: Which of its scripts, from 1. 1 by default.

script_id.description: The id write_scripts answered, to make one of its scripts as a video.

seconds.description: The length: fast videos are 15 seconds, best and priority videos 15 or 30 seconds.

size.description: The shape the video is filmed in. 9:16 is the default.

name: quote_video
title: Price a video
